provenance.format_evidence: PHOTOCHEM/convdist.f: 10-species blocks, each containing NZ rows; then five-column atmospheric block and 12-column aerosol block.
provenance.grid_evidence: PHOTOCHEM/SUBROUTINES/Photgrid.f: NZ=200 gives dzgrid=0.5e5 cm and Z(I)=(I-0.5)*dzgrid.
provenance.gas_evidence: PHOTOCHEM/SUBROUTINES/Output.f labels USOL as long-lived species mixing ratios.
provenance.background_evidence: PHOTOCHEM/SUBROUTINES/Densty.f uses N2 remainder 1-sum(USOL(1:NQ-NP))-FAR when CO2 is long-lived; PLANET.dat sets FAR=0.01.
limitations: Imported reference starting profiles, not a verified converged solution or a unique reconstruction of the Archean atmosphere.
Gas closure follows Densty.f and does not independently reconstruct short-lived species.
Do not map aerosols, M, or photons into gas mass fractions.
Unknown species must be reported when mapping to a target network; do not silently discard and renormalize.

regridding.note: Interpolate only within 0.25..99.75 km. Any surface extension or upper-atmosphere extension requires an explicit policy. Interpolate gas mole fractions with common nonnegative weights to preserve normalization.

reference_atmosphere.note: Reference metadata; the target hydrostatic solver must recompute structure for its own temperature, gravity and boundary conditions.

atmospheric_columns_4_and_5.interpretation: Preserved verbatim. convdist.f labels O3 and SL(NSP-1); template-specific interpretation not verified.

aerosol_block.interpretation: Preserved in source units and order: AERSOL(1:4), WFALL(1:4), RPAR(1:4), per convdist.f.
